source: US Fish and Wildlife Service LEMIS (FOIA), cleaned by Marshall et al. 2025 and Eskew et al. 2020
cite: Marshall, B. M. et al. (2025) Tracing trade: mapping the global dimensions of US wildlife imports. Current Biology 35, 3959-3972. doi:10.5281/zenodo.14982583; Eskew, E. A. et al. (2020) United States wildlife and wildlife product imports from 2000-2014. Scientific Data 7, 22. doi:10.5281/zenodo.3565869.
note: Counts are LEMIS records of imports the US Fish and Wildlife Service seized (disposition S), not quantities. Mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians and arachnids 2000-2022; fish, invertebrates and plants 2000-2014. They show what reached US ports, not all illegal trade.

product_names.TRO: Trophy (all the parts of one animal)
product_names.DEA: Dead specimen (live specimen that died during shipment)
product_names.EGG: Egg (whole dead or blown excluding caviar)
product_names.HOC: Horn carving (including horn or antler products)
product_names.CAR: Carvings (other than bone, horn or ivory)
product_names.SKP: Skin piece (raw or tanned including scraps)
product_names.LPS: Leather product (small manufactured including belt, wallet, watchband)
product_names.LPL: Leather product (large manufactured including briefcase, suitcase, furniture)
product_names.RUG: Rugs (rugs if made from one skin only)
product_names.TUS: Tusks (substantially whole tusks, worked or not)
product_names.PIV: Piano with ivory keys (# of pianos)
product_names.EAR: Ear (except when part of whole trophy)
product_names.PLA: Plates of fur skins (include rugs if made from several skins)
product_names.COR: Coral (raw or unworked, excluding live or coral rock)
product_names.FIN: Fin (fresh, frozen or dried fins or parts)
product_names.SWI: Swim bladder (hydrostatic organ, including isinglass, sturgeon glue)
product_names.TIM: Timber (raw except log or sawn wood)
product_names.VEN: Veneer (thin layers of wood of uniform thickness, usually less than 6mm)

purpose_names.B: Breeding in captivity or artificial propagation
purpose_names.L: Law Enforcement / Judicial / Forensic use only

source_names.A: Plants that are artificially propagated, parts and derivatives
source_names.C: Animals bred in captivity, parts and derivatives
source_names.F: Animals born in captivity, Resolution conf. 10.16
source_names.R: Specimens originating from a ranching operation
